page.overview:
What is Beldum?

Beldum is a long, robotic Pokémon with three claw-like appendages on its backside. Beldum has one red eye that is on a sphere that is attached to the rest of its body.

Beldum uses magnetism to move, communicate, and attack.

Beldum evolves into Metang starting at level 20 and then evolves into Metagross starting at level 45.

This Pokémon learns no moves by Breeding.
